text: Artificial Intelligence is developing quickly. Today we have "narrow AI," which can do one task well, like translating languages. But many researchers want to create "general AI," also called AGI. AGI would think and learn like a human across many different areas. This could bring huge benefits, such as solving problems in medicine and climate change. However, there are also risks. Some experts worry that AGI could be hard to control or might take jobs away from people. Predictions about when AGI will arrive vary widely. Some say it could happen in ten years, while others think it is still far away. Nobody knows for sure.
